title: Raise the bar with iPhone Duo
description: Discover how to adapt your navigation, toolbars, and tab bars for the unique displays of iPhone Duo. Explore the design principles behind the new bar layout, and learn how to configure custom view representations and manage overflow to build powerful, responsive apps.
